sources.entry: Genealogy - Record family members and their relationships and build a family tree. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Genealogy is a free, MIT-licensed PHP/Laravel web application for recording family members and their relationships and building family trees.
summary.what_it_does: Genealogy lets users record persons and couples, linking biological father and mother, parents, partners, children and siblings. Ancestor and descendant family trees are generated with recursive common table expressions. Teams (via Laravel Jetstream) provide multi-tenancy with owner, manager, editor and member roles that control what each user can create, read, update or delete. Persons can have multiple photos with watermarking and multiple document uploads, and events are shown in a timeline. The app includes a built-in backup manager with scheduled daily backups, a log viewer, activity logs for persons, couples and teams, and a password generator. It is available in 11 languages and includes partial GEDCOM import and export, which the README describes as still under active development.
use_cases: share a family tree with relatives
genealogy research with photos and documents
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cp .env.example .env
Configure APP_URL and MySQL/MariaDB connection in .env
php artisan key:generate && php artisan storage:link
composer run dev (or npm run build for assets only)
notable: Family trees built with recursive CTEs to avoid N+1 queries
Team-based multi-tenancy with role-based permissions per person and couple
Built-in backup manager with scheduled backups and email notifications
Activity logging for persons, couples, teams and users
Available in 11 languages, with a Docker image published to GHCR
caveats: GEDCOM import and export are incomplete and under active development; the README recommends backing up the database first
Production requires HTTPS, and the app does not support right-to-left languages
Requires a MySQL/MariaDB database with recursive CTE support and a cron-driven scheduler and queue worker in production
